limits: All six issued fields are for untrimmed raised-rail eoere-bottom-rail-tnut-clearance-v1. Current trimmed/aligned-wire geometry has no new response field; fixed old forces with new local geometry are sensitivities.
Dry DF-L No.2, CD=1, inherited tabulated values and explicitly identified CF=1.3 tension scenario. Actual species, grade, moisture, grain, flaws and dimensions are unobserved.

Reduced-depth NDS shear is a rectangular bending-member component; current trimmed cleat values use local dimensions as parameter sensitivity. No universal sawn-lumber Ft-perp or numerical all-mode cleat capacity is introduced.

Parallel row tearout acts parallel to grain toward an end and here uses one bolt at a time; a sloping-end ray substitution is not adopted square-end qualification. Full moments and connected groups remain separate.
Washer CAD probes prove nominal geometry under a bounding catalog annulus, not delivered parts, seating, stiff pressure distribution, preload, physical couples or metal grade/combined strength.
No Cg/Cdelta invented, EC5 characteristic resistance converted to an ASD allowable, shared wood/steel bolt stack capacity summed, floor qualification or climber rating claimed.

Original five-file bounded packet stays frozen. This followup retains only the scoped calculation, inputs, compact result and verification; raw probe rows and complete pins stay in the ignored reproducer output. No raw-run pruning.
